cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to another measure.
cues.zh: 講師：這支影片要介紹另一個指標。

cues.en: Seemingly different measure of relationship between variables.
cues.zh: 看起來是衡量變數關係的不同指標。

cues.en: And that is called cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 叫作餘弦相似度。

cues.en: It sounds really cool.
cues.zh: 聽起來很酷。

cues.en: It sounds like it's related to geometry and all sorts of weird high dimensional spaces.
cues.zh: 好像與幾何，以及各種奇怪的高維空間有關。

cues.en: But it turns out that it's actually a pretty straightforward concept.
cues.zh: 但其實概念相當直接。

cues.en: And in fact it's really closely related to the Pearson correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 而且與皮爾森相關係數非常密切相關。

cues.en: So cosine similarity is not identical to the Pearson correlation, but it's very similar.
cues.zh: 餘弦相似度與皮爾森相關不完全相同，但非常相似。

cues.en: So, this will be a pretty short video actually.
cues.zh: 所以這支影片其實會很短。

cues.en: Because it's a fairly straightforward concept.
cues.zh: 因為概念相當直接。

cues.en: So, here is the formula for the Pearson correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這是皮爾森相關係數的公式。

cues.en: There's nothing new in this formula.
cues.zh: 公式裡沒有新東西。

cues.en: So, I'm not really gonna talk much about it.
cues.zh: 所以不會多談。

cues.en: If this still looks confusing, or if you've never seen this formula before, then it's probably because you skipped the lecture on correlation coefficient formula.
cues.zh: 如果仍覺得困惑，或從未看過這個公式，可能是因為你跳過了相關係數公式那一堂。

cues.en: Anyway, so that's a reminder.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡提醒一下。

cues.en: Here we have the formula for cosine similarities.
cues.zh: 這是餘弦相似度的公式。

cues.en: So, we say that the cosine of the angle between two variables, and in a geometric term we think of this as these variables
cues.zh: 我們說，這是兩個變數之間夾角的餘弦。從幾何觀點，把這些變數

cues.en: as being vectors in a N dimensional space.
cues.zh: 看成 N 維空間中的向量。

cues.en: So, there's N elements in these vectors.
cues.zh: 向量中有 N 個元素。

cues.en: So, we have N dimensional space.
cues.zh: 所以是 N 維空間。

cues.en: And then these variables are essentially like a line in that space.
cues.zh: 這些變數基本上就像空間中的線。

cues.en: So X is one line in an N dimensional space.
cues.zh: X 是 N 維空間中的一條線。

cues.en: Y is another line in that N dimensional space.
cues.zh: Y 是同一個 N 維空間中的另一條線。

cues.en: And we want to compute the cosine of the angle between them.
cues.zh: 我們要計算兩者夾角的餘弦。

cues.en: Now, you might remember from your high school classes on trigonometry, that the cosine of an angle varies between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 你可能記得高中三角學，角度的餘弦介於負 1 到正 1。

cues.en: And the cosine is minus one when the two lines meet at 180 degrees.
cues.zh: 兩條線形成 180 度時，餘弦為負 1。

cues.en: So, they are going in opposite directions.
cues.zh: 也就是朝相反方向。

cues.en: And the two lines, or sorry, the cosine of the angle between them is one, when the two vectors are exactly on top of each other.
cues.zh: 兩條線——抱歉，是兩者夾角的餘弦——在兩個向量完全重合時，為 1。

cues.en: When they're parallel.
cues.zh: 也就是平行時。

cues.en: Furthermore, the cosine of the angle between two vectors is zero, when the angle between those two vectors is 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 另外，兩個向量的夾角是 90 度時，餘弦為 0。

cues.en: Which you would say is orthogonal.
cues.zh: 這稱為正交。

cues.en: And then in this context, we would call that a zero correlation.
cues.zh: 在這個脈絡下，就稱為零相關。

cues.en: So, here's the formula for the cosine of the angle between two variables.
cues.zh: 這是兩個變數夾角餘弦的公式。

cues.en: Or cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 也就是餘弦相似度。

cues.en: Now what I would like you to notice is that the cosine similarity formula is almost identical to the Pearson correlation formula.
cues.zh: 希望你注意，餘弦相似度公式與皮爾森相關公式，幾乎完全相同。

cues.en: The only difference is that here, we are subtracting the mean, in each case.
cues.zh: 唯一差別是，這裡每一處都減掉平均值。

cues.en: So, this is XI minus the mean, XI minus the mean.
cues.zh: Xᵢ 減平均值，Xᵢ 減平均值。

cues.en: YI minus the mean, YI minus the mean.
cues.zh: Yᵢ 減平均值，Yᵢ 減平均值。

cues.en: Here we are not subtracting the mean.
cues.zh: 這裡則沒有減掉平均值。

cues.en: So you can take a moment and think about when the correlation coefficient and the cosine similarity will be exactly the same.
cues.zh: 可以花點時間想想，相關係數與餘弦相似度，在什麼情況下會完全相同。

cues.en: They will be be literally exactly the same.
cues.zh: 確確實實完全一樣。

cues.en: When was that?
cues.zh: 什麼時候？

cues.en: What circumstance does that arise in?
cues.zh: 哪種情況會發生？

cues.en: You guessed it, I'm sure.
cues.zh: 相信你猜到了。

cues.en: It is when the data are already mean centered.
cues.zh: 資料已經做過平均中心化時。

cues.en: So, if the data both variable X and variable Y are already mean centered.
cues.zh: 也就是 X 與 Y 兩個變數都已經平均中心化。

cues.en: So, you've already subtracted the mean, or maybe they have a mean of zero just because of the nature of the data, then basically you can just, you know.
cues.zh: 已經減掉平均值，或因為資料本身性質，平均值原本就為 0，那基本上，

cues.en: These are all minus zeros, so you can exclude them.
cues.zh: 這些都是減去 0，可以省略。

cues.en: And then cosine similarity is exactly equal to Pearson.
cues.zh: 餘弦相似度就會精確等於皮爾森相關。

cues.en: And when the mean is close to zero.
cues.zh: 而當平均值接近 0，

cues.en: So, when the mean is very small, close to zero, then these two are going to be not really identical, but very similar.
cues.zh: 也就是很小、接近 0 時，兩者雖不完全一致，但會非常相似。

cues.en: And the more the variables have a mean offset, the less similar these two quantities are going to be.
cues.zh: 變數平均值的偏移愈大，這兩個量就愈不相似。

cues.en: Nonetheless, the interpretation of cosine similarity, is the same as the interpretation of the Pearson correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 儘管如此，餘弦相似度的解讀方式，與皮爾森相關係數相同。

cues.en: So, it's not really a fundamentally different measure of the correlation between two different variables.
cues.zh: 所以它並不是衡量兩個變數相關的根本不同指標。

cues.en: It's like a variant of the Pearson correlation.
cues.zh: 它像是皮爾森相關的一種變體。

cues.en: Now, if you are familiar with linear algebra, if you've taken linear algebra courses, for example, my linear algebra course, then you would know that the cosine
cues.zh: 如果熟悉線性代數，上過線性代數課，例如我的課，你會知道兩個向量夾角的餘弦，

cues.en: of the angle between two vectors is equal to the dot product of those vectors divided by the product of the norms.
cues.zh: 等於兩向量的內積，除以兩者範數的乘積。

cues.en: The euclidean two norms of those vectors.
cues.zh: 這裡指的是向量的歐幾里得二範數。

cues.en: And that's exactly what this formula says.
cues.zh: 這個公式說的正是如此。

cues.en: So, this is the dot product.
cues.zh: 這是內積。

cues.en: We have element wise, multiplication and sum.
cues.zh: 先逐元素相乘，再加總。

cues.en: And here we have the euclidean two norm of vector X.
cues.zh: 這裡是向量 X 的歐幾里得二範數。

cues.en: So, we square all the individual elements.
cues.zh: 將各個元素平方。

cues.en: Sum them up and take the square root.
cues.zh: 加總，再開平方根。

cues.en: And then here is the norm of vector Y.
cues.zh: 這裡則是向量 Y 的範數。

cues.en: Now, if everything I just said sounds weird and foreign and mysterious, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果剛才這些聽起來奇怪、陌生又神祕，不用擔心。

cues.en: You don't need to get these linear algebra concepts to understand cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 不必理解這些線性代數概念，也能了解餘弦相似度。

cues.en: I'm just trying to link it to other areas of mathematics that you might be familiar with.
cues.zh: 我只是想把它連結到你可能熟悉的其他數學領域。

cues.en: Okay, so that's basically the end of this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片基本上就到這裡。

cues.en: I just wanted to mention this term cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 只是想介紹餘弦相似度這個名詞。

cues.en: And point out that it's very similar to Pearson correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 並指出它與皮爾森相關係數非常相似。

cues.en: It is identical to the correlation coefficient, when the variables are already mean centered.
cues.zh: 當變數已經平均中心化時，它就與相關係數完全相同。
